resale_co.name: Resale Certificate (new Certificate of Occupancy on change of ownership)
requirements: All construction permits must be closed before a housing inspection can be scheduled
Application must be complete (closing date, block/lot, owner, buyer, agent, inspection contact, email for the certificate) or it will be denied
The Borough forms page lists this Resale Certificate as covering smoke and carbon monoxide compliance

fees.label: Initial inspection, per unit
fees.quote: These are per unit costs Initial Inspection: $125.00

fees.label: Emergency inspection (added to the original inspection fee)

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Resale Certificate Registration form (closing date, location and unit, block/lot, owner, buyer, real estate agent, contact for inspection and email to send the certificate) and deliver it with payment to the Construction Department, second floor of Borough Hall, 355 North Avenue, Dunellen. The form has office fields for check or exact cash. Call the Construction Office to schedule.

evidence.quote: A new certificate of occupancy shall be required for any and all changes of ownership, tenancy or use.
evidence.doc_date: 2005-08 (Zoning Chapter 115, section 115-10 E, amended August 8, 2005; compiled copy amended through October 2007)

evidence.quote: It shall be unlawful to use or permit the use of any building or premises or part thereof hereafter created, located, erected, changed, converted or enlarged wholly or partly until a certificate of occupancy has been issued by the Borough of Dunellen for the premises certifying that the structure complies with the provisions of this chapter.
Resale Certificate Registration ***NO HOUSING INSPECTIONS CAN BE SCHEDULED UNTIL ALL CONSTRUCTION PERMITS ARE CLOSED***
This application will be DENIED if there is missing information.
Resale Certificate - Smoke & Carbon Monoxide Compliance
Construction Official / Building Sub-Code Scott Brescher
Construction Office 355 North Avenue Dunellen, NJ 08812 (732) 968-3323

resale_co.notes: Dunellen Zoning Chapter 115, section 115-10 E (posted on the Borough site as a scanned PDF) requires a new certificate of occupancy for any change of ownership, and the Construction Department posts a current Resale Certificate Registration form (June 2026) with closing date, buyer and agent fields. The resale form does not list the items inspected. The Borough posts a separate Rental Certificate Application with a Rental Inspection checklist (exterior, interior, egress, 10 year sealed battery smoke alarms, CO alarms within 10 feet of bedroom doors, and a 2A:10B:C extinguisher) for rentals; it is not quoted here as a resale checklist. Emails for Construction Office staff are shown only behind an email-protection link, so no email is recorded. The Construction Office number (732) 968-3323 is from the Construction page contact box; the Borough main number is 732-968-3033.

authorities.name: Borough of Dunellen Construction Department (Resale Certificate - Smoke & Carbon Monoxide Compliance)
authorities.how_to_apply: The Borough forms page labels its Resale Certificate Registration as "Resale Certificate - Smoke & Carbon Monoxide Compliance". Its fee ($125.00 per unit initial inspection) is listed under the town certificate; it is not a second charge.

evidence.quote: Resale Certificate - Smoke & Carbon Monoxide Compliance

fire_cert.notes: Conflict to confirm by phone. The NJ DCA registry (July 2026) lists Dunellen as county-enforced (code C), and the state fire directory (survey 1/12/2026) lists the Middlesex County Fire Marshal (Michael Gallagher, (732) 316-7174) as the smoke detector compliance contact. The Borough forms page, however, labels its own Resale Certificate as "Smoke & Carbon Monoxide Compliance", which suggests the Borough resale inspection also checks smoke and CO alarms. The Borough page does not say that the Borough issues the state smoke/CO certificate itself, so it is not clear the two sources really differ. In neighboring county-enforced Highland Park, the Borough page says smoke/CO inspections are done by the Middlesex County Office of the Fire Marshal and must be registered with it; that page lists the county office at (732) 316-7171, firemarshal@co.middlesex.nj.us. No county fee schedule could be opened (the county website blocked automated access). The Dunellen Fire Department (volunteer, dunellenfd.com) is the suppression company, not an inspecting agency.

open_questions: Does the Borough Resale Certificate inspection satisfy the state smoke/CO certificate, or must the seller also get a certificate from the Middlesex County Fire Marshal? If the county, what are its fees?
What does the Borough resale inspection check, and how many days before closing should the application go in?
